name: Orchestrator Self-Improvement ExecutionPlan
description: ExecutionPlan demonstrating the orchestrator coordinating its own enhancement - the ultimate test of ExecutionPlan functionality

tasks.prompt: Analyze current orchestrator capabilities by examining src/generic_orchestrator.py and identify areas for improvement
Research orchestration enhancement patterns and identify specific opportunities to improve the current orchestrator based on the analysis
Design specific improvements to the orchestrator system based on identified opportunities - focus on ExecutionPlan integration enhancements
Implement enhancements to the quality gate system based on the designed improvements
Implement enhancements to the monitoring system based on the designed improvements
Create comprehensive tests to validate that the self-improvements work correctly and don't break existing functionality
Generate a comprehensive report documenting the self-improvements made by the orchestrator, proving the self-coordination concept

metadata.significance: This ExecutionPlan proves the orchestrator can coordinate its own development
